title: Authenticate and anchor persisted TrustStore snapshots
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/key_persistence.py TrustStorePersistence calls itself tamper/fail-closed storage but trust_store.json contains only attacker-recomputable JSON and an in-file revision. Deleting the file returns None; restoring any older valid snapshot is accepted on restart; and a locally writable forged snapshot can choose arbitrary derived keys, trust levels, revocation flags, and rotation floors. This can erase TOFU pins/revocations or replay an old key-rotation authorization. Pair the snapshot with a local authentication key and independent monotonic revision/deletion anchor, fail closed after initialized-state deletion or rollback, bind all policy fields, and test deletion, byte-valid forgery, and old-snapshot restoration.
